artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let X be a complex Banach space and L(X) the Banach algebra of bounded linear operators on X. For T ∈ L(X), the n-th Weyl number is
  x_n(T) = inf{ a_n(T A) : A : ℓ_2 → X, ‖A‖ ≤ 1 },
where a_n denotes the n-th approximation number. For 1 ≤ r < ∞, the Weyl operator ideal of Lorentz type L^{WEYL}_{r,∞} consists of all operators T (acting between arbitrary Banach spaces) such that
  ‖T‖_{L^{WEYL}_{r,∞}} = sup_{n≥1} n^{1/r} x_n(T) < ∞.
For an operator ideal I and parameters (p,q), one denotes by I^{APP}_{p,q} the sub-ideal of all T ∈ I that additionally belong to the approximation-number Lorentz ideal L^{APP}_{p,q}, i.e. sup_{n≥1} n^{1/p} a_n(T) < ∞ when q = ∞.

Trace. For 1 ≤ r < ∞ there exists a (continuous, unitarily invariant) trace
  φ_{r,∞}( · | L^{WEYL}_{r,∞} ) : (L^{WEYL}_{r,∞})^{APP}_{r,∞}(X) → ℂ,
defined on the component over each Banach space X, that is constructed from the Weyl ideal L^{WEYL}_{r,∞} (via a Dixmier-type / extended-limit procedure on its quasi-Banach component).

A trace φ on a two-sided operator ideal I (defined for every Banach space) is called spectral if for every Banach space X and every T ∈ I(X),
  φ(T) = Σ_{n} λ_n(T),
where (λ_n(T)) is the eigenvalue sequence of T counted with algebraic multiplicities (the series being absolutely convergent for T in the relevant ideal).

Question. For each 1 ≤ r < ∞, decide whether the trace φ_{r,∞}( · | L^{WEYL}_{r,∞} ) on (L^{WEYL}_{r,∞})^{APP}_{r,∞} is spectral.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as an explicit open problem (Problem 15) in Pietsch's compilation of open problems on traces on operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. No subsequent published resolution of the spectrality of this Weyl-generated trace was located in web searches; related work on Weyl numbers, eigenvalue inequalities, and operator-ideal traces does not address this specific question.
